subject: MAP: deliverables & data-use terms for evaluation artifacts
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightretail.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Eval artifacts for MAP — initial ask

Hi Hannah / Rafael,

Thanks again for the demo last week. As we discussed, BrightRetail wants a concrete MAP and the actual evaluation artifacts so our ML team can run offline tests against our catalog use cases. High-level ask:

- Shared dataset (sample + holdout) with labels and schema
- Prompt pack (seed prompts + negative cases)
- Testcases / acceptance criteria and expected pass thresholds

Can you confirm what you’re able to share, what the usage constraints are (storage, retention, redistribution), and a suggested timeline for delivery?

We’re targeting a procurement sign-off and pilot kickoff by the end of Q4; ideally we’d have artifacts in hand ~2 weeks before that.

Samir (cc) will be the technical owner on our side. Let us know if we should put together an official MAP doc or if you’ll send a template.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Product, BrightRetail
jordan.lee@brightretail.com
+1 (415) 555-0123
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightretail.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightretail.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts for MAP — initial ask

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. We can absolutely provide the artifacts for a time-boxed evaluation. I’ve attached a draft MAP (MAP_v1.pdf) that lays out milestones and responsibilities; the high-level plan is below. Rafael / Neha looped for legal / compliance details.

Proposed MAP (short):
- 12/08: sample dataset delivery (anonymized CSV + schema)
- 12/10: prompt pack + testcase bundle (zip)
- 12/11–12/22: BrightRetail runs evaluation; Redwood stands up a shared evaluation runbook and can provide a test-run on our infra if needed
- 12/23: joint results review and decision point

Data-use & sharing constraints (summary):
- Purpose: evaluation only — no production use or rehosting outside agreed environments
- Retention: artifacts can be retained for 90 days from delivery unless an extension is agreed in writing
- Redistribution: no third-party redistribution; internal read-only access allowed for BrightRetail engineers working on the pilot
- Derived models: BrightRetail may run experiments but may not use evaluation artifacts to create a model or derivative dataset that is redistributed

We’ve attached a sample prompt pack and a small testcase CSV for scope. Next steps: Rafael will send the DPA and a short exhibit to capture the restrictions above; once signed we’ll drop the dataset and prompt pack into the shared Drive folder (link in the MAP).

If that timeline works for you I’ll lock the dates and trigger the paperwork.

—
Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightretail.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:48:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts for MAP — DPA and usage exhibit

Jordan — quick follow on from legal. We’ve attached a one-page exhibit and our standard DPA (DPA_Redwood_BrightRetail_signed.pdf). Key points to confirm:

- Storage: artifacts must be stored in BrightRetail’s VPC project or in the shared Drive folder we provision; if stored in S3/other cloud, encryption at rest is required
- Retention: default 90 days; requests to extend beyond that require executive approval and a retention amendment
- Audit & logging: Redwood will provide basic access logs for artifact downloads; detailed audit (full access logs) can be provided for an additional compliance add-on
- Redaction: if BrightRetail needs additional redaction (PII removal) we can provide a scrubbed sample; note that heavy redaction may affect evaluation fidelity

Please sign the DPA exhibit and reply with the email address you want provisioned for Drive access. I’ll also attach a small README with dataset schema and a checklist for running the tests.

Rafael Mendes
Sr. Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@brightretail.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>, Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightretail.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 3 Dec 2026 14:10:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Eval artifacts for MAP — quick clarifications

Thanks, Hannah / Rafael. The timeline looks reasonable and the constraints sound standard. A couple items from our side:

- Retention: 90 days should be fine, but can you confirm a mechanism to request an extension (who signs off)?
- Derived models: we need a carve-out for internal experiments that do not redistribute the model outside BrightRetail — i.e., we may train internal experimental models but commit not to publish or sell derivatives that materially reproduce the dataset.
- Test environment: can Redwood provide a short-run example evaluation on your infra (one run) so we can sanity-check our setup?

We’ll sign the DPA exhibit and send back the primary email for Drive provisioning: samir.patel@brightretail.com.

Jordan

Jordan / Samir — great, thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and links so we’re all aligned:

Mutual Action Plan (finalized):
- 2026-12-08: dataset delivery (anonymized sample + holdout) — attachment: testcases_sample.csv
- 2026-12-10: prompt pack + testcase archive — attachment: eval_prompt_pack_v2.zip
- 2026-12-11 to 2026-12-22: evaluation window (BrightRetail runs tests)
- 2026-12-23: results review & go/no-go decision via joint call

Paperwork & provisioning:
- DPA/exhibit sent (attached DPA_Redwood_BrightRetail_signed.pdf). Please sign the DocuSign envelope here: https://www.docusign.com/ENVELOPEID=12345
- Drive folder (read-only for evaluation team): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP — we’ll provision samir.patel@brightretail.com once we have the signed DPA

Data-use reminders (summary):
- Evaluation-only; no external redistribution
- Retention limit: 90 days from delivery; to extend please email legal@redwood.inference.com with justification — Rafael will route approvals (exec sign-off required for >90 days)
- Internal experiments permitted for analysis only; no commercialization or public redistribution of derivative datasets or models

Logistics: I’ve attached the MAP (MAP_v1.pdf) and the sample testcases. Rafael, Neha — flag if anything missing from the exhibit. Jordan / Samir — if the schedule looks good I’ll mark calendar invites and create the shared Drive links.

Thanks — looking forward to the pilot.

—
